plan.title: PR to PO conversion with SAP sync

steps.note: Configure the SAP PR sync mode required by the dependency.
Enable the dependent automatic PR-to-PO conversion setting.

args.title: PR to PO Conversion SAP Sync Test

steps.note: Commit a valid bidding schedule before publishing.
Add the participant required for a bid and award.
Confirm the event reached a real published project page.
Submit a vendor response so the event can be awarded and converted to a PO.
Close the bidding window so awarding is permitted.
Award the submitted response to initiate the PO-producing flow.
Confirm the award proposal was created and submitted.
Complete the available PO creation flow as the closest observable check of PR-to-PO conversion.
Verify the resulting PO contains the awarded PR-derived line items.
